Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S24 Note prompts match Vikram's original word for word, and Mistral calls carry the same guardrail as Haiku

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T3 The note prompts and templates are unchanged from Vikram's original except approved changes; any other wording change has Vikram's approval on record. (TFA-92592 AC 13; TFA-94229 AC 1; TFA-94229 R1; TFA-94229 R2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress
  • T7 Mistral calls go through the same Bedrock guardrail as Haiku. (TFA-94422 AC 4)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Prompt library on main (note/clinical-quality 1.7, note/patient-context, note/snf-patient-context, templates soap, hp, consult, discharge, snf-progress, snf-admission) and prompts.lock.json; prototype RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html; convex/ai/providers/bedrock.ts

When Diff each note prompt against the prototype (whitespace-normalised) and list every difference with its approval; read the Bedrock call path for Haiku and Mistral

Then Every difference is an approved change (TFA-92592 AC 6/7/10/16 fixes, the #100 EARLIER VALUES block); the same guardrailConfig (id and version) is sent for both models

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Doc review. #100's wording has not been reviewed by Vikram yet (TFA-92592 AC 13 note), so any EARLIER VALUES text in the build is an unapproved difference until he signs off

Where it ran: local code-review (judged by reading the code); test method STATIC · Static check (build output / scan); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane code-review.

Test method: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: code-review.
